name: Imaging Reader
artifact: imaging_signal{label, p_calibrated, heatmap, cam_metrics, quality, provenance}
job_description: Read the kidney CT as soon as it reaches PACS. Run the classifier and the attention heat map, check image quality and out-of-distribution risk, calibrate the confidence, and return a preliminary imaging signal to the clinician's board only, through the Dispatcher, for the Safety Verifier and the Case Briefer. Never call it a diagnosis, never report anything to the patient, never alter the image. Radiologist review is required.
